author: István Kovács
name: kofa Highlight Details Presets
description: Ever enabled sigmoid or filmic and watched a beautiful sky turn flat and lifeless? These two presets bring the detail back: the local contrast module, pre-masked to target only the highlights, restores crisp texture to skies, clouds and other bright areas while leaving the rest of the image untouched. Pick the regular version for a clear effect or the subtle variant for a gentler touch, and fine-tune the mask to fit your photo.
